editor_empty_body: Import a file or change the filters.
feature_context_body: Comments, screenshots and translation memory right next to each key.
feature_formats_body: i18next, Rails and gettext files keep their key order, nesting and comments.
feature_git_body: Source strings come from your repo, translations go back as a pull request on a dedicated branch.
feature_history_body: Every change is a revision. Review statuses keep quality visible.
feature_icu_body: ICU MessageFormat under the hood, with the right plural forms for every language.
feature_mt_body: Pre-translate with AI on the agency plan, placeholders stay intact.
files_empty: No files yet. Import one above.
files_subtitle: Download the latest version of each file per language.
import_path_hint: Use %locale% where the language code goes. Leave empty to derive it from the file name.
import_subtitle: Import the source file first to create keys, then translations for other languages.
landing_kicker: Translations that ship with your code
landing_subtitle: wortwerk reads your source strings from GitHub or Bitbucket, lets your translators work in a focused editor and sends the result back as a pull request.
magic_link_sent_body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}.
members_subtitle: Everyone in the workspace can do everything for now.
new_key_body: Keys from files are created on import. Add keys here for projects without files.
onboarding_subtitle: A workspace holds your projects and team.
plan_billing_soon: Online billing is coming soon. Contact us to upgrade.
plan_mt_upgrade: Machine translation is available on the agency plan.
projects_empty_body: Create a project and import your first translation file.
projects_locales_hint: Language codes like de, fr-CH or pt-BR, separated by commas.
projects_new_body: You can connect a repository or import files afterwards.
projects_subtitle: Each project has its own files and languages.
run_summary: {added} keys added, {changed} translations changed, {obsoleted} obsolete, {skipped} skipped
settings_delete_body: This deletes all keys, translations and history. Type {slug} to confirm.
settings_locales_body: Removing a language hides it from the editor. Its translations are kept.
settings_obsolete_body: {count} keys are no longer in the source file. They are kept with their translations until you purge them.
sign_in_subtitle: We'll email you a sign-in link.
step_connect: Connect a repository and point wortwerk at your locale files.
step_merge: wortwerk opens a pull request with clean, minimal diffs. You review and merge.
step_translate: New keys show up automatically. Translators fill the gaps with memory and context.
